title: Method expressions match direct method-call advice and fail to compile
claim: The pinned method-call matcher accepts method expressions with a receiver type as selector.X. The strings.Builder.WriteString and strings.Replacer.Replace pointer advice then substitutes that type as a runtime receiver, causing valid woven customer code to fail compilation.
repro_command: Place .omo/review/evidence/hooks-yml-strings/zz_review_strings.go in iast/internal/propagationtest/ and zz_review_strings_test.go in iast/propagation/ of the private copy; from its root run GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test -timeout 15m -count=1 -run TestReviewReplacerReceiverAndArgumentEvaluateOnce -v ./iast/propagation
